`python/sglang/srt/` unless prefixed `python/sglang/kernels`, `rust/`, `docker/`

(for example `serving_chat.py` and `protocol.py` are in `entrypoints/openai/`,
and `schedule_policy.py` is in `managers/`), not root-level files.

from `UNION_SOURCE_VALIDATION_20260922.md`; this read-only audit did not rerun
the suites or claim new GPU evidence.
